name: DrawBorderCard
description: Card that traces its own rounded outline with a single SVG stroke on hover or focus, using a normalised pathLength so the stroke matches the card radius at any size.
a11yNotes: Root is a focusable <article>; the stroke draws on hover and on focus-within so keyboard users get the same affordance, and the SVG outline is aria-hidden. Under prefers-reduced-motion the full outline fades in instead of drawing.

defaultProps.title: Draw Border Card
defaultProps.body: Hover or focus the card and a single stroke traces its outline, matched exactly to the corner radius.

propsApi.description: Card body copy (ignored when children are provided).
